--- Page 18 ---
STRATEGY FOR GROWTH
Key Takeaway: PLT’s growth strategy is anchored in essential LPG logistics demand, stronger international Time Charter 
contribution, and disciplined cost and fleet management to support resilient cash flow and long -term value creation.
18Strategy for Growth
4. Protect Earnings Quality
•Prioritize recurring and high -quality revenue 
streams through contract visibility, Time Charter 
arrangements, and balanced exposure between 
long-term contracts and selective spot 
opportunities.
2. Cost Discipline & Operational Efficiency
•Improve vessel utilization, manage fuel and 
maintenance costs, and align capacity with 
demand visibility. 
•Maintain an agile operating structure to respond 
quickly to shipment volume, freight market, and fuel 
price changes.
3. Strengthen Financial Resilience
•Preserve liquidity and balance sheet flexibility 
through disciplined capital allocation, scheduled 
debt repayment, and selective investment in high -
return fleet opportunities.
1. Structural Growth Positioning
•Build on PLT’s stable domestic COA revenue base 
while expanding international Time Charter 
opportunities. Align fleet deployment with resilient 
LPG demand in Thailand and growing regional 
energy trade across Asia.
